analysis_status: Exploratory reconstruction, not preregistration. Parameters fixed before inspecting the reconstructed candidate-performance correlations.
wasserstein: Exact empirical Wasserstein-1 on all derived scalar observations, no standardization or subsampling
histogram_range: Global minimum and maximum across the four full speed arrays
histogram_smoothing: Normalize counts, add epsilon to each bin, renormalize to sum one
mmd_rng: numpy.random.default_rng (PCG64), tasks sampled sequentially in canonical order, without replacement
mmd_standardization: Pooled full-speed mean and population standard deviation, reused for all task pairs
mmd_estimator: Square root of nonnegative-clipped biased squared V-statistic including within-task diagonals
mmd_pairing: One fixed sample per task reused for all pairs, symmetric values assigned together
